Maya: Heads-up — Kestrel Labs just dropped to ~15% of prior weekly token usage since last Wednesday. Seen on dashboard.
Arjun: Yikes. Any product/infra issues reported?
Maya: No incidents. They mentioned new internal ML lead joined — CTO replaced. Could be procurement pause. Also running competitor trial per account notes.
Priya (AM): I had a call yesterday — they are testing LlamaX via partner. They liked latency but price was better. We offered cost-optimizations but haven't heard back.
Dan (AE): Can we offer a short Dedicated trial or credits? What's their ARR?
Maya: ~$420k ARR, mid-enterprise. Likely 6-month renewal in Q3. Risk flagging.
Arjun: Let's escalate to Solutions Eng for a targeted cost playbook + quick demo of batching/quantization. @Leo can you do a 30m on Wed?
Leo (SE): Yep, can do Wed 10am PT. Will prepare delta report: token profile + 2 quick config knobs.
Priya (AM): I'll prep conversation and confirm stakeholders (new ML lead + procurement). Maya, can you share recent eval logs and sample prompts?
Maya: Pasting sample: ```{"prompt":"summarize transaction","avg_tokens":420}``` ... also attaching usage timeline link: https://redwood.app/accounts/kestrel/usage
Priya (AM): Thanks. I'll loop in AE and legal if they ask about data residency.
Dan (AE): Also confirm whether they're on hosted or dedicated — affects price.
Maya: Hosted. Also they asked about private deployment briefly.
Arjun: Plan: 1) SE cost audit + quick config, 2) AM-led stakeholder sync with demo & offer (2-week Dedicated trial or 30% pilot credit), 3) follow-up playbook doc. Owner: Priya. Deadline: EOW to propose.
Priya (AM): Aye. I'll run a stakeholder map today and propose outreach.
Leo (SE): Prep notes — will include estimated $/token delta if they enable caching + 4-bit quant. Need sample workloads.
Maya: Pinged new ML lead on Slack earlier, awaiting reply. If silence by EOD tomorrow, we open a high-touch sequence.
deploy-bot: Incident alert resolved: no platform regressions in last 7d :white_check_mark:
Priya (AM): Thx. Everyone ok if I schedule Wed 10am PT with Leo + Maya + Dan + their new ML lead? I'll send calendar invite once confirmed.
Arjun: Yes. Adding retention playbook link: https://redwood.app/playbooks/renewals/cost-negotiation
Maya: Thanks team. Marking as renewal-risk and tagging for QBR.
